en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a crowd gathered around stone arches and a spring emerging from a rocky hillside. Above the arches stands a long, low building with a tiled roof. The terrain is mountainous and rocky. There is printed bilingual titling in Greek and French at the bottom, plus handwritten Greek text across the lower margin. A circular postal cancellation mark is visible in the upper right.
